summary: A grocery-store-themed one-pager for Fraunces, Undercase Type's 'Old Style' (wonky) variable family for Google Fonts with four axes (opsz, wght, SOFT, WONK). Black, white and supermarket-orange bands carry shop-sign slogans ('Honk for Wonky Fonts', 'Please Wait to be Seated', 'Thank You for Shopping With us!') with price-tag stickers, and each axis gets its own slider demo, a with/without optical-size wipe and an instance picker.

instances.look: Slim orange top bar, 'Fraunces Roman & Italic' in small bold left and an underlined 'Download' link (GitHub releases) right

On black, 'Fraunces' in heavy soft white and 'Roman & Italic' below, then 'An “Old Style” Typeface Family by Undercase Type' in light orange (last line italic), with four tilted price-tag stickers slapped on top: green star 'NEW SMOOTH FONT!', green 'Typographer.', red 'Just looking!', green round 'SPECIAL'
instances.ux: Stickers drop in one by one on load, at randomised positions, tilts and scales; header Download link
instances.learn: Treat stickers as a second voice: a few price-tag jokes ('Just looking!') over a serious title make the genre's attitude clear without extra copy
